Day Night

Inglenook

A cozy, soothing color theme: technology meets simple life charm. Two equal variants. Day is a cabin room in natural light, with plants on the sill. Night is a Victorian library by the fire. Both are easy on the eyes, with calm, evenly matched colors and one warm accent, firelight, that marks where you are.

Everything below is live HTML, colored from the same palette as every port. The switch at the top changes the whole page between Day and Night.

kettle.py
# Brew a pot and note how long it steeped
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class Kettle:
    name: str
    litres: float = 1.7

def steep(kettle: Kettle, minutes: int = 4) -> str:
    if minutes > 6 and not kettle.name:
        raise ValueError("too strong")
    return f"{kettle.name}: {minutes} min"

print(steep(Kettle("copper"), 3))  # copper: 3 min
steep(kettel)

Every color

Nine plain neutrals and twelve named colors per variant. The ratio is the contrast with base; for the surfaces it is the contrast of text on them. Terminal colors run normal then bright, black to white.

Roles

Ports pick a role or a named color, never a value. Each role has one meaning in every app. Oxblood and ivy are detail colors for badges and small accents, with no role.

RoleMeansDayNight
accentYou are here: focus, cursor, selection, links, primary buttons
errorFailure, removal
warningCaution, change
successSuccess, addition
infoInformation, in progress
keywordKeywords, booleans, constants
referencePaths, references, anchors
literalNumbers, flags, literals
typeTypes
tagTags, annotations, decorators
on_accentText on an accent fill

Syntax

Every editor and highlighter port colors code the same way. A token that does not fit takes the closest row.

TokenColorDayNight
Keys, properties, functionsinfosteep()steep()
Stringssuccess"copper""copper"
Numbers, flags, literalsliteral1.71.7
Keywords, booleans, constantskeywordreturnreturn
TypestypeKettleKettle
Paths, references, anchorsreferencedataclassesdataclasses
Tags, annotations, decoratorstag@dataclass@dataclass
Errors, invaliderrorkettelkettel
